#### Gradient for a layer's weight matrix

A layer computes $\vz = \matr{W} \vhidval + \vecf{b}$,
and the [gradient](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/linear-regression.html#def-gradient) $\vbackerr = \gradwrt{\vz} \loss$ of the loss with respect to its output is known.
What is the gradient of $\loss$ with respect to $\matr{W}$?

:::
